workflow_runs.name: regression_test
workflow_runs.display_title: Fixed stack address truncation with MISRA stack checking

head_commit.message:
Fixed MISRA stack alignment on ports with 64-bit pointers

MISRA stack checking converted the stack address through 32-bit ULONG.

Preserved ALIGN_TYPE width in both stack-alignment conversions. Added a
native-width behavioral regression that fails on the original code.

Focused and single-core checks passed. Local SMP ERROR #7 also occurred
on the unchanged baseline; final-head upstream SMP CI remains required.
The human contributor reviewed and confirmed the contribution.

Fixes: eclipse-threadx/threadx#744
Assisted-by: Codex (gpt-6.1-sol) <noreply@openai.com>
